raw_header:
Terms and Conditions
A limited number of guest passes are available to Max subscribers only. Once your
guest passes, they can no longer be redeemed. Each pass provides the recipient with a
7-day free trial ofClaude's Pro plan, which includes Claude Code. Recipients must not
have a previous Claude subscription history (on any Claude product) and must enter
payment information to activate their trial. Each free trial will automatically convert to a
paid pro plan at the end of the free trial period unless the recipient cancels before then.
Passes have no cash value and are non-transferable. Offer availability and terms are
subjecttochange.
